Changes: Bug Fix: Auto-update feature was broken in the previous update (v0.9.2), and the pop-up prompt to accept the Configurator app update was being hidden. This has now been fixed.
Bug Fix: Prevented 'Refreshing Local Files...' from appearing on top of the auto-update progress bar while the Configurator app is updating to a newer version.
UI Polish: Revised Configurator app to match Windows theme colour on first launch. This can still be manually changed using the Dark / Light mode toggle in the footer of the Configurator app.
UI Polish: Updated project logo to use 'SOP' instead of 'Lua' in the icon and image.
Bug Fix: Prevented pop-up prompts from appearing while the Configurator app is updating to a newer version.

Architecture Overhaul: Configurator app will now automatically download all updated MAME State Output Plugin files, changelog files, and supported game files into the local roaming folder. This will ensure that you can always uninstall or install the last version of the plugin that was downloaded, as well as access the changelog and list of supported games, regardless of current internet connectivity.

Architecture Overhaul: Renamed array within 'changelog.json' from 'Updater' to 'Configurator'. This will break the auto-update function in older versions of Configurator app (v0.9.0 and below), so I will leave the old auto-update method enabled on the server up until v1.0.0 is officially released.
Feature Added: Uninstall button has been added to the Home page, which will remove MAME State Output Plugin from all configured MAME instances and safely adjust all relevant configuration files.
Optimisation: Cleaned up config.json file stored in AppData > Roaming > MameStateOutputConfigurator folder.
Optimisation: Enabled background processing while dialog prompts are open where appropriate (i.e. while downloading/installing/updating files after user confirmation).

Optimisation: Improved network sniffing resource utilisation in the Diagnostics page when enabled. This includes thread optimisations for network management, brush assignment, memory allocation, message queue for displaying state output log in app UI, better handling for large exports, etc.

Optimisation: Removed redundant code and technical debt that was used in earlier beta releases but is no longer required. and cleaned up config.json file stored in AppData > Roaming > MameStateOutputConfigurator folder.
Optimisation: Removed 'stateoutput 1' from being added to mame.ini for new installs. This will now only be added to plugin.ini as it should have to begin with.
UI Polish: Added colour coding and expanded information regarding cases where 'Multiple Found' is encountered for installed versions.
UI Polish: Added expand / collapse button ('Show Information') to MAME and Hooker Program pages to reduce cluttered default view.
UI Polish: Adjusted the top grid layout and 'Sniffing' toggle colours in the Diagnostics page.
UI Polish: Clarified help text for RetroBat MAME instances.

UI Polish: Implemented offline mode to improve user experience for arcade cabinet users. Please note that an internet connection is required the first time the Configurator app is launched, and any subsequent launch will use locally cached plugin files if no internet connection is available.

UI Polish: Logic changed for clearing the MAME State Output Log in the Diagnostics page so that if 'Continuous Log' is off (default), then any time a ROM is closed it will not clear the log history until a new ROM is launched. This assists in preventing accidental clearing of log history during testing of a specific ROM.

UI Polish: Renamed 'Continuous' to 'Continuous Log' in the Diagnostics page. This is disabled by default, which will result in the MAME State Output Log resetting when the active ROM is changed in MAME (which helps to keep the log clean). If this is enabled, the MAME State Output Log will keep a log of every state output value change across all ROMs encountered during the sniffing session.
UI Polish: Renamed 'Installed MAME State Output' to 'Installed', and renamed 'Latest MAME State Output' to 'Latest'.

UI Polish: Renamed 'Polling (ms)' to 'UI Refresh Rate (ms)' in the Diagnostics page, since this is only applicable to the speed at which the MAME State Output Log is updated in the UI of the app (not the speed at which messages are being read from MAME).
Architecture Overhaul: Renamed the folder in AppData/Roaming from 'MameStateOutputUpdater' to 'MameStateOutputConfigurator'

Bug Fix: Fixed typo in logic for individual player state output values relating to 'Shots Fired Primary'. This was previously referencing the total 'Shots Fired' value, but it should have been referencing shots fired by the primary weapon only.
Bug Fix: Improved network protocol to only automatically reveal individual player state output summary tables if the active ROM is in the list of supported games.
Bug Fix: RetroBat specific changes to ensure this is correctly configured for the MAME State Output Plugin and enabled in EmulationStation UI.

Featured Added: When the app is started, it will download a local copy of changelog.json and games.json from GitHub, but if GitHub can't be reached then the last local copy that was downloaded will be used instead. If no local json files exist, then the app will load empty UI lists instead of getting stuck.
Bug Fix: Improved network protocol to prevent dropped/missed state output event changes when using 'Diagnostics' sniffer.
Bug Fix: RetroBat now works correctly for installing MAME State Output Plugin and configuring all relevant files based on MAME instance selections.
UI Polish: Added 'RELOAD' to the individual player state output triggers.
Bug Fix: Miscellaneous bug fixes and logic improvements.

UI Expansion: Added a dedicated 'Diagnostics' tab featuring a complete state output monitoring suite that can be used to check if your MAME State Output Plugin is working correctly (turned off by default to save on system resources). This is also useful for checking state outputs from other MAME games too, with the ability to export the log for use with other software and tools.
UI Polish: Relocated the dark mode toggle into the footer, which improves the user interface when adjusting the app window size.
UI Polish: Split Changelog release notes into two separate sub tabs (plugin and configurator).
Bug Fix: Renamed a few old instances of 'Updater' and replaced with 'Configurator'.
UI Expansion: Added a dedicated 'Changelog' tab featuring release notes for each MAME State Output Plugin and Configurator App. This also includes manual downloads for each release, where applicable.
UI Expansion: Added a dedicated 'Games' tab featuring a list of supported games / ROMs based on the currently installed MAME State Output Plugin.
UI Polish: Fixed scrollbar theme to suit dark mode better.
UI Polish: Configurator app starts wider to better fit text within the app window.
App Renamed: Officially rebranded from 'Updater' to 'MAME State Output Plugin Configurator' to better reflect its comprehensive feature set.
Architecture Overhaul: Migrated the background update engine to use a centralized master changelog.json, separating deployment metadata from UI data.
Bug Fix: Patched a routing trap where selecting a deep RetroBat subfolder manually would cause the engine to double-append the mame path
UI Expansion: Added a dedicated 'About' tab featuring version tracking, clickable GitHub repository links, and comprehensive community credits.
Memory Optimization: Replaced localized HTTP clients with a global static instance, permanently sealing network socket memory leaks.
Logic Refinement: Rebuilt the local MAME plugin scanner to use a highly optimized JSON Document reader, bypassing bloated data models.
Bug Fix: Fixed a major XAML/C# race condition where saving custom directory paths via the 'Browse Folder' button would fail due to file-locking conflicts.
UI Polish: Increased the width of the directory configuration grid columns to prevent 'Browse Folder...' text from being cut off.
Bug Fix: Enforced strict unchecking and graying out of the Output Mode (Network/Windows) radio buttons if the local MAME version is missing or explicitly unsupported (pre-v0.200).
Validation Failsafe: Added logic to ensure all Off-Screen Reload toggles are forcefully disabled if mame.exe cannot be read or verified.
Feature Added: Implemented the automatic INI Sync Engine. The app now seamlessly reads and modifies mame.ini and plugin.ini to ensure output configurations match the user's UI selections.
Feature Added: Introduced the Self-Updating engine with real-time UI overlay, progress bars, batch-script executable swapping, and extraction loops.
Feature Added: Added version detection logic to intelligently disable 'Plugin Helper' off-screen reloads for any MAME version older than v0.285.
Feature Added: Implemented the 'Legacy Architecture' conflict detector. The app now actively scans for old LUA scripts and prompts users to upgrade and migrate to the new plugin architecture.
UX Improvement: Added dynamic instructional text to the Root Directory textbox that changes based on the selected directory structure.
Feature Added: Introduced the Multi-Instance MAME configuration framework, allowing users to route and manage multiple distinct MAME installations simultaneously.
UI Overhaul: Replaced basic text fields with the dynamic, color-coded Validation Table (Green/Orange/Red) to give users instant visual feedback on their configuration status.
Feature Added: Added real-time GitHub version checking to compare local installations against the online repository.

Bug Fix: Added safety clamp to check for recoil interval and hold interval being less than or equal to recoil duration.

Bug Fix: Fixed the counter for ShotsFiredPrimary so that it only counts shots fired based on 'Ammo' changes if Ammo is known, otherwise it will default to a simpler logic that will +1 for every recoil state event.
Bug Fix: If individual player credits are utilised for a game rather than global credits, then global credits will now equal the total combined number of individual player credits.

UX Improvement: Disabled debug OSD mode by default, which removes the text during ROM launch that states whether the active ROM is supported by the State Output Plugin (Not Supported = Dormant, Supported = Active).
Bug Fix: Fixed 'PX_Recoil' fallback logic if PX_Ammo is not known for the active ROM.
Bug Fix: Fixed 'PX_Recoil' logic for manual memory address polling (this was missed in the migration from the old Lua script architecture to the new plugin architecture).
Bug Fix: Fixed 'PX_Recoil' logic so that it doesn't freeze with a value of 1 (clashed with ammo math tracker, and would not reset back to 0 until another action reset the loop).
Bug Fix: Fixed logic for Demulshooter compatibility toggle (adds PX_Recoil and PX_Damaged state outputs with that specific naming convention).
Bug Fix: Fixed 'PX_Damage' not being triggered in logic when processing life lost state events.
Initial beta for testing state outputs using MAME plugin architecture.

v7 and below are incompatible with the Configurator app as they utilised the older MAME Lua Script architecture. This version is being included only for archival purposes, as it was the last Lua script based release for this project.
